vetSays.line: 🛡️ Teresa, Ingrid, Jasper and Maya met them at the door — 4 put down. Teresa, Ingrid, Jasper, Maya are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Ingrid, Jasper, Maya and Xavier met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Ingrid, Jasper, Maya, Xavier are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Loud Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Jasper. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Loud Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Loud Beast!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader The Loud Beast, The Loud Beast (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jasper just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jasper just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jasper just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
💥 The Elder Big Loud SNAPS! No warning. There never is.
Elder Big Loud hits you for 2.
